comment: All candidates shared the same architecture, so optimizer progress dominated. AdamW C and Adagrad A had comparable displacement estimates (0.154 and 0.136), with C benefiting from no decay; RMSprop B had less estimated progress (0.051). Momentum SGD E remained slower on the deep, unnormalized network, while D’s tenfold lower learning rate made it last. K1001, K1002, K1003, K1005, and K1019 supported this ordering. K1012 appropriately cautioned that close cross-optimizer displacement estimates alone could not establish C over A. No new general rule follows from this single confirmed ranking.
